My team is available:
- Tue 3/3 10:00–12:00 PT
- Wed 3/4 13:00–16:00 PT
- Thu 3/5 11:00–14:00 PT

We prefer Zoom (company policy) and will be in a large conference room for most folks — note the room AV has been flaky (projector/mic), so we may need to dial in from a secondary room if the projector fails.

Also please include any pre-read architecture docs if you have them. I’ll loop in procurement shortly.

Thanks,
